visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene begins at a traditional Taiwanese open-front eatery during the daytime. Customers, including a woman in a bright blue and pink jacket holding a cane, wait in line. The lighting is bright and natural, showing steel counters and busy staff. (2) Close-up macro shots show a chef's hands using a heavy rectangular cleaver to chop whole cooked goose into pieces on a large wooden block. The meat looks moist and golden-skinned. (3) The perspective shifts to the cooking area where staff handle bowls and use long ladles to dip into deep metal vats of boiling soup and noodles. (4) A top-down shot reveals a table spread with several dishes: sliced goose meat topped with ginger, goose blood cake drizzled with sauce, and a plate of stir-fried goose organs with chives. (5) Fast-paced macro shots showcase individual ingredients being lifted with chopsticks: a piece of creamy goose liver, a springy goose heart, and crunchy chives. The lighting is focused and warm. (6) Close-up of goose blood cake slices arranged in a triangle pattern, followed by goose meat slices being dipped into a brown savory sauce. (7) A spoonful of rice topped with shredded goose meat is lifted toward the camera, showing a glistening texture. (8) A vertical colorful sign outside lists menu items in Traditional Chinese characters. (9) The video concludes with an wide outdoor shot of the street and the shop's storefront with address text overlays.

An upbeat acoustic guitar BGM with a steady pop beat provides a lively foundation. Faint street and chatter noise floor is audible. (2) As the visuals show meat being chopped, the percussive 'thwack' of a heavy knife hitting a cutting board becomes a prominent incidental acoustic feature, synced with the narration. (3) The narrator's pitch rises slightly during the description of different dishes, emphasizing freshness and taste. The acoustic environment shifts to a slightly more resonant room tone reflecting the indoor shop. (4) High-arousal vocal delivery highlights specific ingredients, accompanied by the clinking of metal bowls and utensils. The BGM remains constant in tempo and volume. (5) The recording concludes with a structured summary, where the music fades out alongside a concluding professional sign-off tone.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Historical Context -> Product Showcase -> Sensory Evaluation -> Conclusion.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote a famous 'nameless' goose meat restaurant in Kaohsiung by highlighting its 70-year history, popularity (demonstrated by queues), and the high quality of its specialty dishes like sliced goose and goose organs.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video is a personal food discovery vlog under the brand '虎麗笑嗨嗨', focusing on authentic local experience rather than a paid sponsorship.
